spec_match.rationale: Implements the explainer's core use case (page-supplied domain vocabulary suppressing false positives) with real addWords/removeWords calls over a spellcheck-enabled textarea, and honestly labels squiggle visibility as manual observation since no API reads it back.

interactive.rationale: Batch add/remove chips, a single-word add field, and a live editable draft; every button drives the real API and reports its genuine outcome.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises real calls with manual-observation framing for squiggles; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Empty input, unavailable surface (per-call honest not-attempted message), and thrown errors are all distinct outcomes.

conformance.rationale: The suite's squiggle-suppression contract is a manual assertion naming this page's textarea procedure; call-level contracts run live.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: batch and single adds both reported the honest not-attempted state; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read. Squiggle observation requires a flagged desktop browser with spell check on and is not claimed.

telemetry_health.rationale: scd-editor-call and scd-editor-unavailable asserts record each outcome.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; ≥44px controls; textarea uses the serif body face for a wiki feel with AA contrast.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled textarea and word input; chip group labelled; status aria-live.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Editor grid collapses under 760px; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Observe real squiggle suppression behind the flag
openQuestions.detail: On flagged Chrome 153 with spell checking enabled, verify added terms lose their squiggles in the draft and that the words remain flagged on other origins (ignored-not-learned semantics).

guidanceConsulted.query: textarea spellcheck word manager accessible labels
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Label editing surfaces and inputs programmatically.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Textarea and word input carry aria-labels; buttons are native.
Status line is role=status aria-live, reporting each real call.
Grid collapses under 760px; verified 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the manager drives real calls with per-call honest outcomes on Chromium 141; the squiggle payoff is correctly framed as manual observation and deferred to a flagged browser.
